request.text: The APT-Simulator account on WORKSTATION5 is running Cobalt Strike-style named-pipe and service tricks to obtain SYSTEM. Disable account APT-Simulator.

package.rationale: As APT-Simulator, cmd.exe started a named-pipe server (CreateNamedPipe.exe 334485) and created service tbbd05 whose binary path echoes into \\.\pipe\334485; services.exe then ran that command as SYSTEM, so the pipe server can impersonate the SYSTEM token. This is token impersonation through a named pipe from the APT-Simulator account; disable it now.
